description: Phase 3b (A20): the user entity as GET /me, /sync/bootstrap and /sync changes present it. 'fields' must all be present; 'never' must never appear. city and country_code are labels the user typed or picked (never GPS); avatar_version counts photo changes (0 = never had one); has_avatar is true while a photo exists (false after removal, so other devices show initials without asking). Readers tolerate any of the 3b fields being absent (an older server) and unknown extras. The dart suite joins in 3b.2.
